ei.title: 에너지 구성을 변화시킬 교통수단으로서 자전거 보급 확대의 필요성

fullPassage: To affect society's energy mix, bicycles must be used widely for transportation, not just recreation. They are ideal for short-distance commuting and running errands: 22 percent of commutes in the United States and 35 percent in Canada are less than 5 kilometers (km), well within comfortable bicycle range. At a reasonable 20 km/hour (12 miles/hour), this means about a 15-minute ride. Bicycles offer transportation on demand — no walking to and waiting for a bus or tram. A bicycle is also inexpensive, at about 2 percent of the cost of an automobile. Maintenance is similarly inexpensive, though bicycle parts are by nature fragile because they must be light. Parking is usually right outside the door of the destination, making cycling faster than driving for many urban applications.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

To affect society's energy mix, bicycles must be used widely for transportation, not just recreation.

(A) A bicycle is also inexpensive, at about 2 percent of the cost of an automobile. Maintenance is similarly inexpensive, though bicycle parts are by nature fragile because they must be light.
(B) They are ideal for short-distance commuting and running errands: 22 percent of commutes in the United States and 35 percent in Canada are less than 5 kilometers (km), well within comfortable bicycle range. At a reasonable 20 km/hour (12 miles/hour), this means about a 15-minute ride.
(C) Bicycles offer transportation on demand — no walking to and waiting for a bus or tram.

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): 비용이 먼저
❌ ② (A)-(C)-(B): 비용이 먼저
✅ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): (B) They가 bicycles를 받아 적합성 설명 → (C) 수요형 교통 → (A) also로 비용 추가
❌ ④ (C)-(A)-(B): 흐름 단절
det.tip: They → Bicycles → also 순서

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bicycles offer transportation on demand — no walking to and waiting for a bus or tram. A bicycle is also inexpensive, at about 2 percent of the cost of an automobile.

(A) Parking is usually right outside the door of the destination, making cycling faster than driving for many urban applications.
(B) Maintenance is similarly inexpensive, though bicycle parts are by nature fragile because they must be light.
(C) To affect society's energy mix, bicycles must be used widely for transportation, not just recreation.

det.analysis:
✅ ① (B)-(A)-(C): (B) similarly로 비용 이어감 → (A) 주차 장점 → (C) 결론
❌ ② (C)-(B)-(A): 결론이 먼저
❌ ③ (A)-(B)-(C): 주차가 비용보다 먼저
❌ ④ (A)-(C)-(B): 흐름 단절
det.tip: similarly → Parking → must be used 순서
